description: Runs a ready-made app published to a public app hub as a live jengakit app, from its hub link or name. No source code needed.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. pengbai/docker-supermario, alpine:3.22.4, or any https://hub.docker.com/r/, /_/, /layers/ URL
ui.description: Pulls a pre-built Docker Hub image and deploys it directly. No source code required. Accepts Hub URLs (/r/<owner>/<repo>, /_/<image>, /layers/<owner>/<repo>/<tag>) or plain image refs (name:tag, owner/repo:tag). Port is auto-detected from image metadata; 80 / 8080 / 3000 / 8000 / 5000 / 4000 win when multiple ports are exposed. Base-OS images without a service (alpine, ubuntu, debian) are rejected up-front. linuxserver/* and kasmweb/* images get --shm-size=1gb and seccomp=unconfined automatically.

sample_prompts: Deploy a Docker Hub image as a jengaKIT app

user_inputs.label: Docker Hub Username
user_inputs.hint: Required only for private images. Leave blank for public Docker Hub images.

user_inputs.label: Docker Hub Token / PAT
user_inputs.hint: Personal Access Token from hub.docker.com → Account Settings → Security.
